# Evergreen Resilience Institute

> Where frontier science meets community resilience. An independent, not-for-profit research institution (Calgary, Alberta, Canada) advancing AI-driven Earth observation and climate resilience.

Evergreen Resilience Institute (ERI) is an independent research foundation combining frontier Earth-science research (satellite hydrology, AI/ML-based water cycle monitoring) with community-level climate resilience work in Calgary's Bow River Basin.

## Site sections
- [Home](https://evergreenresilience.org/) — mission, research focus, projects, team, and publications
- [Team & Publications](https://evergreenresilience.org/#team) — researcher bios and selected publications

## Research Projects
- [Global-to-local Water Cycle Monitoring](https://evergreenresilience.org/projects/global-water-cycle/)
- [Bow River Basin AI Network (BRAIN)](https://evergreenresilience.org/projects/brain/)
- [Food-Energy-Water Nexus](https://evergreenresilience.org/projects/food-energy-water/)
- [Community Engagement](https://evergreenresilience.org/projects/nature-journaling/)
